title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site improvements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: provide clear RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding for common workflows and to reduce support tickets. This PR adds opinionated templates for RAG agents, step-by-step quickstarts for the console and SDKs, and small docs site improvements including interactive code snippets and a troubleshooting section. Changes include: 1) new rag templates (python + typescript) with example connectors for S3 and Pinecone, 2) agent tool-calling examples demonstrating function/tool manifests, structured output validation, and streaming responses, 3) updated quickstart guide on redwood-docs with clear environment and KMS notes for Private deployments, 4) docs site sidebar reorganized to surface agent/quickstarts, and 5) small bugfixes to example prompts and README links. Testing: verified examples run locally with the dev stack and in the examples CI job; unit tests for snippet formatting added. Related: ENG-3112, PRs #26045 and #25510. Checklist: [x] add RAG templates and agent samples [x] docs quickstart + troubleshooting [x] SDK snippets validated [x] CI examples job added [x] reviewers addressed feedback. Release notes: see release_notes field.
